name: Popover
summary: Shows anchored contextual content in a dismissible dialog surface.

obligations: Expose the trigger relationship, dialog name, and placement.
Contain focus and dismiss on Escape or outside press when enabled.

behavior: Delegate portal mounting, anchor positioning, modal focus behavior, and topmost dismissal to RAC Popover and Dialog.
Require a focusable trigger and toggle controlled or uncontrolled state through RAC DialogTrigger.
accessibility: Expose aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the trigger.
Require aria-label or aria-labelledby for the dialog content surface.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
